dream: I pressed the turnip down until it slid into the hot corner. The card hummed loud, making the heavy block feel like a drawing. I swapped the tall rock for a small one, trusting the lean to catch the weight. Then the turnip grew wings and lifted the whole stack into the air. The rough edge bit nothing, just drifting in a circle. I pressed the statue block down hard, feeling the wood press into my own flat paper skin. The air felt thin, so I let the slide choose where to go. It slid off the edge and caught the fence gate. I was wide and the fence was narrow, so I pressed the gate down until it felt like a real wall. The dream ended with the card cooling, making the weight float again.
